# Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration

# Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.5.1 · generated 2026-11-12 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] The Terraform and Pulumi import notes warn that third-party notifications do not contain their sensitive credentials. To update those notifications without the original credentials, the corresponding `notifier_id` (Terraform) or `notifierId` (Pulumi) must be provided. (medium confidence) — https://registry.terraform.io/providers/mongodb/mongodbatlas/latest/docs/resources/alert_configuration · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/

## How it works

- [statement] The provider changelog records a 2.8.0 fix, dated March 11, 2026, for errors when updating alert notifications, thresholds, or metric thresholds without specifying all optional attributes. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- [statement] For Terraform provider v2.8.0, the alert read implementation removes the resource from Terraform state when its not-found check succeeds. A successful read converts the returned alert into the refreshed Terraform state. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/tags/e49de3204be1e2b47776c33e6b8833ae358f7de1 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/v2.8.0/internal/service/alertconfiguration/resource.go

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Release attribution differs: the maintainer closing issue 305 said its fix was included in 0.7.0, while the changelog lists the billing-alert deletion failure under v0.8.0-pre.1 in its fixed-bugs section. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/305 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- [statement] The Terraform provider v2.8.0 alert update implementation reads the existing alert, removes computed group and timestamp values from the request, copies changed enablement, event, matcher, and threshold values, rebuilds notifications, and submits an update for the existing alert identity. The implementation comment explains that the original alert configuration is needed to avoid a server error. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/tags/e49de3204be1e2b47776c33e6b8833ae358f7de1 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/v2.8.0/internal/service/alertconfiguration/resource.go
- [statement] The released v0.7.0 alert read implementation handles an error containing `404` for an existing resource by clearing its Terraform identity and returning successfully. The audited v0.6.4, v0.6.5, and v0.6.6 implementations instead return the read error directly. This release-bound comparison supports the issue closure's v0.7.0 attribution, while the separately preserved changelog listing under v0.8.0-pre.1 remains a different attribution; the comparison does not establish a first fix across all earlier releases. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/matching-refs/tags/v0.6 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/ref/tags/v0.7.0, https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md, https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/305, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/c60cff3edaa7f681673ed1e7f05d6e1d0a84b701/mongodbatlas/resource_mongodbatlas_alert_configuration.go

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] In issue 1927, a reporter using provider v1.15.1 and Terraform v1.5.7 confirmed that using `threshold_config` instead of `metric_threshold_config` solved the billing-alert configuration problem. Maintainer oarbusi explained that `metric_threshold_config` requires `metric_name` and advised `threshold_config` instead. The resource documentation requires `metric_threshold_config` when `event_type` is `OUTSIDE_METRIC_THRESHOLD` or `OUTSIDE_SERVERLESS_METRIC_THRESHOLD`. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/1927 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://registry.terraform.io/providers/mongodb/mongodbatlas/latest/docs/resources/alert_configuration

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Terraform and Pulumi document importing an existing alert configuration with the composite identifier project_id-alert_configuration_id; their examples use terraform import and pulumi import respectively. (medium confidence) — https://registry.terraform.io/providers/mongodb/mongodbatlas/latest/docs/resources/alert_configuration · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] The Terraform alert resource documentation says some validations were removed to unblock alert creation as alert variables change, and directs readers to the Atlas API documentation for current information. (low confidence) — https://registry.terraform.io/providers/mongodb/mongodbatlas/latest/docs/resources/alert_configuration
- [statement] HashiCorp documents that `terraform plan` and `terraform apply` refresh state against real infrastructure by default. A `-refresh-only` operation reviews and records drift without modifying remote infrastructure; normal plan or apply can instead attempt to revert manual changes. (low confidence) — https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials/state/resource-drift
- [statement] The reporter in issue 305 used Terraform v0.12.21 and Atlas provider 0.6.4. The report describes a billing alert deleted through the website causing a 404 during plan, and website changes to its event type or amount failing to be restored from configuration. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/305
- [statement] The provider changelog lists a fix for alert-configuration drift detection in v1.8.1, dated March 7, 2023. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- [statement] The provider changelog lists avoiding a state difference after import for an undefined optional alert-notification attribute among the v1.12.0 changes, dated September 20, 2023. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- [statement] The Pulumi package states that it is based on the mongodbatlas Terraform Provider. (low confidence) — https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] In the released Terraform provider v2.8.0 alert resource schema, `project_id` and `severity_override` each use `stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace()`. The schema exposes the alert event, enablement, matchers, thresholds, and notifications separately. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/tags/e49de3204be1e2b47776c33e6b8833ae358f7de1 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/v2.8.0/internal/service/alertconfiguration/resource.go
- [statement] In Terraform provider v2.20.1, the complete alert schema marks only `project_id` with `stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace()`; `severity_override` is optional without that replacement modifier. The update method copies a changed severity value into the existing alert update request, and the read method still removes a missing resource from state. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/tags/292c1b7006df191d5fca8b4aaa4e1cc87cc86d59 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/d589548ae439bc8efb734220b222138d379cf6e4/internal/service/alertconfiguration/resource.go
- [statement] The Pulumi v4.18.1 source checkout pins its upstream MongoDB Terraform-provider submodule to commit d589548ae439bc8efb734220b222138d379cf6e4, the commit targeted by the annotated Terraform provider v2.20.1 tag. Its provider module replaces the Terraform-provider dependency with the local upstream checkout. This establishes the source version relationship, without establishing the version used by any deployment. (medium confidence) — https://api.github.com/repos/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/git/tags/292c1b7006df191d5fca8b4aaa4e1cc87cc86d59 · keywords: Infrastructure-as-code alert configuration · also: https://api.github.com/repos/pulumi/pulumi-mongodbatlas/git/ref/tags/v4.18.1, https://api.github.com/repos/pulumi/pulumi-mongodbatlas/git/trees/v4.18.1?recursive=1, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pulumi/pulumi-mongodbatlas/v4.18.1/provider/go.mod
